firmware.title: FRANK Quest
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; ScummVM team
firmware.description: Adventure games on Cabal, a ScummVM fork: SCUMM, Sierra AGI and SCI, Gobliiins and Kyrandia. Bring your own game files.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard and mouse. Esc: skip a scene, Space: pause, Ctrl+Alt+Del: game list.
